content: wasm-bindgen exported structs are boxed as Box<RefCell<T>> and returned to JS as an opaque pointer wrapper; JS object holds the pointer, calling .free() nulls it out (any further method call panics in Rust -- a use-after-free-safe panic, not UB). Passing an owned struct by-value (move) into another wasm-bindgen function neuters the JS-side handle for that argument.
